blocks.html:
This step validates that a cart doesn't have a payment collection.
If the cart has a payment collection, the step throws an error.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

children.name: ValidateExistingPaymentCollectionStepInput
children.description: The details of the cart to validate its payment collection.
